content.what_it_is: Official NTHMP benchmark-1 (BP1, 'Solitary Wave on a Canonical Beach') MATLAB comparison function, authored by J. Horrillo and Gyeong-Bo Kim, NTHMP/NOAA 2011 (header L1-155; references Synolakis 1986 thesis and 1987 JFM; contact block L46-54). function analyBM_01_SW(filename1,filename2) (L1): filename1 = model snapshot matrix 441x8 (x plus eta/h at t=35..65, header spec L75-100), filename2 = model runup time series 241x3 (t, x/h=9.95, x/h=0.25, spec L101-125). Zero/one/two-argument invocation examples (L138-152). Input handling (L156-191): NaN placeholders when absent; loads user file and evals its variable by filename stem (L171-177, L183-189), extracting the model-name prefix str3/str4 for labels. Loads analytical data analytical_SW.mat (x, a_35..a_65, L193) and analytical_RU.mat (t1,y1; t2,y2, L197). Beach geometry X=[-2:1:20], slp=1/19.85, Y=-slp*X (L211-213). Figure 1 (fig2, L218-227): seven stacked snapshot panels t=35..65 (subplot(7,1,k)); for each, when model data present: restrict to -2<=x<=20 (L233-234 etc.), Norm=max-min of analytical (L236), interpolate model onto analytical x (interp1, L237), fill NaNs with the beach line (L240), NRMSD err=sqrt(sum((model-analytical)^2)/N)/Norm*100 (L249 and analogues), max-amplitude error err1 (L251), echo [t max_analytical max_model] (L252); plots slope line, model dashed black, analytical red dots every 5th point, per-panel axis limits (e.g. [-2 20 -0.02 0.04001]), NRMSD/ERR annotations. Figure 2 (fig1, L602-611): two panels for runup cases x/h=9.95 (L615-661: y1n interp, err @L627, err1 @L629, plot vs t1) and x/h=0.25 (L665-711: NaN-filtered y3/t3, y2n interp @L670, err @L681, err1 @L684, plot vs t2 every 20th point, xlabel t(g/h)^{1/2}). Self-contained NRMSD-based model-performance scoring per the NTHMP validation workshop.

verbatim_spans.text: %               Synolakis, C.E. (1987): The runup of solitary waves.
str='-Analytical- Solitary Wave on a Simple Beach';

unresolved: Model files are loaded with load() then materialized via eval of the filename stem (L174, L186) -- requires the ASCII file to load as a variable named after the file; fails for names starting with digits or containing dots beyond the extension.
J index vectors (L234 and analogues) are computed but never used; the t=50 echo uses max(a_50) over the full range instead of max(a_50(I)) (L413) unlike the other panels.

The seven snapshot blocks are copy-paste variants differing only in column index and axis limits; per-panel ax1 ymax values (0.04001/0.06001/0.08001/0.1001) encode expected wave growth -- not parameterized.
err/err1 annotations in each panel show the errors of the preceding computation block; for the analytical-only invocation they stay NaN and are suppressed (if ~isnan guards).
The header calls the case both H=0.019 (L33) and H=0.0185 (L67, L204) -- benchmark nominal vs actual amplitude; which applies to analytical_SW.mat is not resolvable here.
